en: You've met with a terrible fate, haven't you? First-place winner of the 6th Outer Wilds mod jam.

- Added Japanese translation (Thanks orclecle!)
- Prevented the ship log from prematurely revealing certain entries
- Blocked a certain vanilla achievement from triggering while following the normal mod progression
- A certain weather phenomenon has been adjusted to be more reliable
- Corrected the text for a ship log entry that referred to the wrong Hourglass Twin
